ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the circuit shown in the figure, the circuit is in a steady state, and the switch is closed at \( t = 0 \). The time constant of the circuit is ________ ms.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the circuit diagram, on the left side is an independent voltage source labeled 50 V, positive at the top and negative at the bottom; above the voltage source, it is connected through a switch to the upper branch; on the upper left side there is a 5 Ω resistor, and the middle node is connected downward to an independent current source labeled 2 A, with the arrow pointing upward; on the upper right side there is a 10 Ω resistor, and the rightmost vertical branch is an inductor labeled 50 mH, with the bottom being the common lower wire. Reasoning: The time constant after the switch closes at t=0 is required, so the final topology for t>0 is used. When finding the equivalent resistance seen by the inductor, remove the 50 mH inductor from the port, set the independent 50 V voltage source to zero, equivalent to a short circuit, set the independent 2 A current source to zero, equivalent to an open circuit, and keep the switch closed. At this time, looking from the upper terminal port of the inductor toward the lower common node, the path passes successively through the 10 Ω resistor to the middle node, then through the 5 Ω resistor to the left node that is connected to the lower common node because the voltage source is short-circuited and the switch is closed, so R_th = 10 Ω + 5 Ω = 15 Ω. The time constant τ = L / R_th = 50 mH / 15 Ω = 0.05 H / 15 Ω = 0.00333 s = 3.3 ms.

method.method_draft: Use the final circuit for t>0, with the switch closed. To find the time constant, remove/look into the 50 mH inductor terminals and deactivate independent sources: replace the 50 V source by a short circuit and the 2 A current source by an open circuit. With the closed switch and shorted voltage source, the path from the inductor terminal to the bottom rail is through the 10 Ω resistor in series with the 5 Ω resistor, so R_th = 10 + 5 = 15 Ω. Then compute τ = L/R_th = 50 mH / 15 Ω = 0.00333 s = 3.3 ms.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：电路图中左侧是一个标有 50 V、上正下负的独立电压源，电压源上方通过一个开关接到上方支路；上方左侧有 5 Ω 电阻，中间节点向下接一个标有 2 A、箭头向上的独立电流源；上方右侧有 10 Ω 电阻，最右侧竖直支路是标有 50 mH 的电感，底部为公共下导线。推理：要求开关在 t=0 闭合后的时间常数，因此使用 t>0 的最终拓扑。求电感看到的等效电阻时，将 50 mH 电感从端口移除，独立 50 V 电压源置零等效为短路，独立 2 A 电流源置零等效为开路，并保持开关闭合。此时从电感上端端口看向下方公共节点，路径依次经过 10 Ω 电阻到中间节点，再经过 5 Ω 电阻到因电压源短路且开关闭合而连接到下方公共节点的左侧节点，所以 R_th = 10 Ω + 5 Ω = 15 Ω。时间常数 τ = L / R_th = 50 mH / 15 Ω = 0.05 H / 15 Ω = 0.00333 s = 3.3 ms。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct post-switch Thevenin-resistance route for a first-order RL circuit; this is the natural single-solution method for the requested time constant.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the circuit topology and component values from the figure: a 50 mH inductor is in series with a 10 Ω resistor on the right branch; the central top node also connects to a 2 A current source to the bottom rail and through a 5 Ω resistor plus the switch/50 V source branch on the left. The switch is the element that closes at t=0.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the statement that the circuit is initially in steady state and the switch is closed at t=0; the requested quantity is the time constant in milliseconds, so only the final post-switch topology determines τ, not the initial inductor current.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: For an RL first-order circuit after a switching event, the time constant is τ = L/R_th, where R_th is the equivalent resistance seen looking into the inductor terminals with the switch in its final position and all independent sources deactivated: ideal voltage sources shorted and ideal current sources opened.
